dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Dunkin came into ACC as a stray. During his stay in the care center, he has shown high levels of fear, potential for defensive aggression, and handling sensitivity. When his intake was being done, he began growling, snapping, thrashing on the leash, and snarling at staff when they attempted to remove the leashes he had on. During his assessment he growls and snaps at the handler's hands when they attempt to collar him; when the handler pulls back, he lunges and muzzle punches their hand. Due to behavior in the care center, we recommend placement in an adult-only home through a New Hope partner. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Dunkin
